title: A live console shows the kb, coord, running sessions, the query log and the host, and exports the same as OpenTelemetry
goal: python3 _tools/kbmon.py shows, refreshing live in a portable ANSI console view and as one --once or --json snapshot, the kb, coord, the running sessions with the active sprint, the query log and the host, read-only and with no model call; an optional OpenTelemetry SDK adapter under otel/ exports the same as metrics, events as log records and landings, worker runs, suite runs and query-log deliveries as spans over OTLP/HTTP, and serves /metrics on loopback, with id-only redacted attributes
